title: Tree representation under low fanout
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ inputs in which every gate has distinct arguments and at most two arguments, and every NOT gate has exactly one argument. Suppose every vertex with index at least $n$ has fanout at most $1$. Then there is a Boolean circuit tree $t$ on the same inputs that computes the same function as $C$, has maximum fanin at most $2$, and satisfies both size bounds $|t|\leq 3\,\mathrm{length}(C.\mathrm{gates})+1$ and $|t|\leq 4\,\mathrm{size}(C)$.
hypotheses_covered: Every NOT gate has one argument
Every gate has at most two arguments
Every vertex with index at least $n$ has fanout at most $1$
